clue.text: Drudge, like valets with no time to go out

indicators.note: to go out is read as letters breaking ranks, a cue to rearrange what remains
with no tells us a piece is removed from the word valets

explanation.surface: A drudge is like hotel valets who never get time off to go out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' removes T (time) from VALETS, leaving VALES, and 'to go out' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A drudge does hard menial work, much like a servant owned by a master.

clue.text: A completely wet answer?

parts.note: an answer that is entirely wet would be a liquid mixture, while the word also means the answer to a puzzle

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a dissolved liquid mixture and the resolving of a problem.

clue.text: Where to place elbow — or gun

definitions.text: Where to place elbow — or gun

parts.words: Where to place elbow — or gun
parts.note: a support for your elbow on a chair, or read literally a rest for an arm, that is a weapon

explanation.surface: A question about where to put your elbow, or a rifle.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the padded support on a chair's side; split, it is a support for a firearm.

clue.text: Equal — for example, when a learner begins

parts.note: EG abbreviates exempli gratia, for example
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Being equal, for example, at the point when a learner starts out.
explanation.walkthrough: EGAL is a French loan word meaning equal, met in older English.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an archaic borrowing from French with the sense of level or matching.

clue.text: Lose our one chance to see the state

parts.note: to lose a chance is to miss it
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Lamenting a lost opportunity to visit an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the fifty US states, in the Midwest.

clue.text: Susceptible to being stamped on?

parts.note: someone easily influenced, read literally as something able to take a printed mark or stamp

explanation.definitionFit: It means easily swayed, and literally capable of receiving an imprint.

clue.text: A short walk up for domestic animals

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: pets are animals kept in the home

explanation.surface: A brief stroll upstairs taken by household animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A pace is a very small distance walked.

clue.text: Use lint to wind around spatula, maybe

indicators.note: winding the letters round puts the words use lint in a new order

explanation.surface: Advice to wrap some lint around a kitchen spatula.
explanation.definitionFit: A spatula is one example of a kitchen implement.

clue.text: Bury inmate with only one name

indicators.note: with only one says that a doubled letter loses one copy

parts.note: an intern is someone confined, an inmate

explanation.surface: Burying a prisoner who has just a single name.
explanation.walkthrough: INTERN has two Ns; 'with only one' keeps one name, dropping the other.
explanation.definitionFit: To bury a body is to lay it in a grave.

clue.text: Grab Marie? That would be a bit much!

definitions.meaning: a Marie is a plain sweet biscuit popular in Britain, so seizing one is literally taking a biscuit

definitions.text: That would be a bit much!
definitions.meaning: an exclamation that something is the most outrageous yet

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be the most surprising or annoying, and literally to seize a cookie.

clue.text: Sexy dance Ada is a little sheepish to begin?

indicators.note: to begin places the sheepish piece at the front of the name

parts.note: a young sheep is a lamb
the name taken as written

explanation.surface: A shy woman called Ada feels a bit bashful starting a raunchy dance.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a sensual Brazilian partner dance popular around 1990.

clue.text: Here to offer a gift

explanation.surface: Being here in person in order to hand over a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means in attendance, to proffer, and a donation.

clue.text: Pine for such a pedigree

parts.note: a pine is one kind, and a pedigree is drawn as a family chart of this kind

explanation.surface: Longing for a fine lineage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pine is an example, and a pedigree is shown as a branching family diagram.

clue.text: One over the eight? On the contrary!

definitions.text: One over the eight? On the contrary!

parts.words: One over the eight? On the contrary!
parts.note: one over the eight is British slang for drunk; the contrary of one over eight is one under eight

explanation.surface: Someone asking if a drinker has had one too many.
explanation.definitionFit: One less than eight gives this number.

clue.text: Conniving ruse of a drug-addict

indicators.note: conniving suggests scheming, a cue to rework the word ruse

explanation.surface: A drug addict's scheming trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes drugs habitually is called by this term.

clue.text: Formerly in the van

definitions.meaning: at the front, in the vanguard

explanation.surface: Something once carried in the van.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a dialect word for before, and splits as at the front.

clue.text: Order rubbish to be taken back by car

indicators.note: taken back means each of the pieces is read backwards

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit
rot is nonsense, rubbish

explanation.surface: Ordering scrap to be collected by car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be taken back' turns OM into MO and ROT into TOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor is an informal British term for an automobile.

clue.text: Infinitely fabulous

definitions.meaning: beyond the confines of earth, without limit

explanation.surface: Something boundlessly wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means superb, and literally beyond our planet.

clue.text: Speech defects that male masters corrected

indicators.note: corrected implies the letters are put right in a new order

explanation.surface: Teachers fixing speech impediments.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech impediments involving repeated sounds are known by this term.

clue.text: A small-minded scientist

parts.note: small-minded read as one whose mind is on tiny things, organisms seen under a microscope

explanation.definitionFit: This scientist studies tiny organisms such as bacteria.

clue.text: Damages given for harm to society

definitions.text: Damages given for harm to society

parts.words: Damages given for harm to society
parts.note: damages is a verb meaning hurts, read as if it were compensation paid by a court

explanation.surface: Compensation paid for harming the community.
explanation.definitionFit: To damage someone is to hurt them.

clue.text: Fashionable ways of encroachment

parts.note: in means fashionable
roads are ways

explanation.surface: Trendy ways of trespassing.
explanation.definitionFit: Making advances into another's territory is described with this word.

clue.text: Ruler who is open if backward…

indicators.note: if backward says the word for open is read from right to left

parts.note: a door that is ajar is slightly open

explanation.surface: A monarch who is frank in a backward land.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an Indian prince or king.

clue.text: Speed-merchant making a U-turn about car

indicators.note: a U-turn sends the whole run back the way it came

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A fast driver doing a U-turn in his car.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who competes in speed events is so called.

clue.text: …like Samuel, he might buy tea here

parts.note: as means like

explanation.surface: A man like Samuel buying tea.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an Indian state famous for its tea plantations.

clue.text: Get a measure of the play, but miss its finale

indicators.note: miss its finale drops the last letter from the word for play

parts.note: a drama is a play

explanation.surface: Getting a drink at the theatre but missing the ending.
explanation.definitionFit: A small measure of spirits is called by this word.

clue.text: Died at a new town in Scotland

parts.note: OB abbreviates obiit, Latin for died

explanation.surface: Someone died at a new Scottish town.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a coastal resort town in Argyll, western Scotland.

clue.text: No information on melon production

parts.note: O is nil, nothing
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: No facts about growing melons.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ogen is a small sweet variety of cantaloupe.

clue.text: In our cab, I accidentally hit deer

indicators.note: accidentally suggests the letters of our cab I crash into disorder

explanation.surface: Our taxi accidentally ran into a deer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the North American reindeer.

clue.text: Bags on toboggan — the basis for an in-joke

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a luge is a small toboggan
a gag is a joke

explanation.surface: Bags loaded onto a sled as a running joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Bags carried on a journey are collectively baggage.

clue.text: Vibrate at speed, with innate energy — boy!

indicators.note: innate read as in it, placing pieces inside the word for speed

parts.note: rate means speed
E is the physics symbol for energy
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Something shaking fast with natural energy, exclaims a startled observer.
explanation.definitionFit: To echo with sound is to throb or reverberate.

clue.text: Smells bouquets

explanation.definitionFit: A wine's aroma is called its nose, and to nose is to sniff.
